question: After a project-scoped plugin is approved, does its SessionStart hook fire at the first prompt, not just at session/start?

setup.plugin: scratch/e35/repo/plugin — e35-probe, one SessionStart hook `mark` that appends to /tmp/e35-marker
setup.approved_store: scratch/e35/dxg (isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME; the E35 project install and approval)
setup.control_store: scratch/r30-e56/control (fresh isolated XDG; the E35 trust record copied in, then a project install without approve)
setup.trust_precondition: The control store reused the E35 saved-trust record for the same workspace path. That is a precondition, not a new trust measurement.

approved.install: already present from E35; plugin list shows active=true, trust=project-trusted

install.warning: third-party plugin: hooks require review before activation

finding: An approved project-scoped plugin's SessionStart hook fires at the first prompt, after the prompt event and before run.lifecycle.started. An otherwise identical project-scoped install that is review_needed reports no effective capabilities and writes no marker.
branch: D233-A: P5 stands; add the project-scope sentence
scope: One workspace, one hook, one Muse build, one isolated store.
The approved run reused the E35 approval and cache; it did not re-test installation or approval.
The control copied the E35 saved-trust record to satisfy the project-install precondition.
No paid model call: provider echo, zero tokens, one completed call in each run.
artifacts: scratch/r30-e56/ (install/list/inspect/run/marker files); no credentials or account identifiers
